title: Check yourself: Parallel calls, the tool runner and the practice

questions.stem: An assistant turn holds three `tool_use` blocks and the second handler fails. Which return follows the page?

options.text: One user message that carries every result, the middle one flagged as an error
options.says: The page says to "return one `tool_result` for each `tool_use` block, all together in the next user message", and to send `is_error: true` for a call that was not run or failed.

options.text: Two results only, since the failed call has no output that could be sent back
options.says: Ruled out because "Skipping a result leaves a `tool_use` without its answer".

options.text: A text message that tells the model which of the calls had failed and why
options.says: Ruled out because every result is "matched by `tool_use_id`, with every result before any text", and a plain message names no call.

options.text: A separate user message for each call, so that each one can be checked alone
options.says: Ruled out because the wrong form is "a separate user message for each tool result".

questions.stem: Where does `disable_parallel_tool_use` go in a request?

options.text: Within the object that selects how functions get called
options.says: The page says "Set `disable_parallel_tool_use: true` inside the `tool_choice` object."

options.text: Inside each tool definition, next to its name
options.says: Ruled out because "It is a field of the `tool_choice` object."

options.text: In the system prompt, as a line of instructions
options.says: Ruled out because "the field is part of the request body", and a line in a prompt has no such effect.

options.text: Alongside `max_tokens`, at the top level of the body
options.says: Ruled out because "It is not a top-level request parameter."

questions.stem: A loop forced `{"type": "tool", "name": "lookup"}` on every request. What goes wrong?

options.text: The model writes a plan in text before each tool call
options.says: Ruled out because "the API prefills the assistant message to force a tool to be used", so no plan in text comes before the call.

options.text: The model swaps in another tool when it judges one fits better
options.says: Ruled out because the `tool` value "forces Claude to always use a particular tool", with a `name`.

options.text: No final answer in plain text could ever come out
options.says: The page says "If it were sent again, the model would have to call a tool each time and could never give a final answer."

options.text: Plain-text replies still arrive as usual after the first call
options.says: Ruled out because "the model would have to call a tool each time", so a plain-text reply never arrives.

origin.section: Check tool_choice before you send it
